title: Samsung’s next Gallery feature could turn your photos into short videos
summary: One UI 9.5 could help you turn your vacation photos into a highlight reel, for a price.
body: TL;DR Samsung is reportedly working on a new Galaxy AI feature called “Shorts.” It can turn your photos and videos into short, shareable clips automatically or with manual prompts. Shorts could debut with the Galaxy S27 series and could be part of the Galaxy AI Premium subscription. Samsung has started rolling out the One UI 9.5 beta to the Galaxy S26 series , and it’s packed with new features. However, it seems Samsung is also working on plenty of features that aren’t yet available in the beta. We’ve already spotted an improved Driving Report in One UI 9.5 , and now we’re seeing reports of another feature that could let users turn their photos into short videos. According to a report from SamMobile , the feature is called “Shorts,” and it could be built into the Gallery app. It would let users turn their photos and videos into short, shareable clips. Samsung’s description of the feature says that Shorts can be created automatically, or users can make and edit them manually.

title: Samsung could end annual Galaxy Watch releases starting in 2027
summary: Fewer hardware launches could mean more time for meaningful upgrades.
body: TL;DR Samsung reportedly plans to skip new Galaxy Watch models in 2027, breaking its annual release tradition. The move to a two-year launch cycle aims to reduce development and marketing costs. Samsung plans to focus on software updates and new health features for existing Galaxy Watches. Not every smartwatch needs a new model every year. Apple demonstrated that when it waited two years between the Watch Ultra 2 and Ultra 3, releasing only a new color in between. And with yearly hardware improvements becoming increasingly modest, there’s a growing debate over whether annual upgrades are still necessary. Samsung could now take things a step further by abandoning yearly Galaxy Watch releases altogether. According to a new report from South Korea’s ETNews , Samsung has decided to skip new Galaxy Watch releases in 2027 and move the lineup to a two-year launch cycle. If accurate, that would break a nine-year tradition of annual releases dating back to the first Galaxy Watch in 2018.

title: Molly Meldrum to Receive State Funeral as Kylie Minogue, Jimmy Barnes Lead Tributes
summary: "I'm going to turn the music up in your honour," wrote Minogue, who Meldrum welcomed onto Countdown as a teenager.
body: Ian “Molly” Meldrum will be honored with a state funeral, as tributes pour in from across the music world for the Australian broadcaster and record producer, who died Monday (Nov. 23) in Melbourne at 83. Kylie Minogue , who appeared on Meldrum’s Countdown as a teenager at the start of her career, remembered him as one of her earliest inspirations. “He championed so many Aussie artists and welcomed international artists to Australia in his own wonderful and inimitable way,” she wrote. “I’m so grateful for his unwavering love and support. Vale Molly. I’m going to turn the music up in your honour.” Jimmy Barnes offered the most complicated tribute, recalling that Meldrum was initially an adversary — “running the best music TV show in the country but insisting that we had to mime.” The relationship changed. “Molly exposed us to a huge music audience we could never have reached, and we were always thankful to him for that,” Barnes wrote on Instagram. Tina Arena , a longtime friend, posted a gallery of images. “I’m deeply saddened by the passing of Molly Meldrum, a man who made an incredible contri…

title: Inside Stockholm’s Gasometer, Europe’s Most Ambitious New Music Venue: ‘This Will Create Waves Far Beyond Here’
summary: The venue will host its opening performances in March 2027.
body: On a frigid November morning, Julien Planté , head of music at Miramis, and the team lead a preview tour of Gasometer, a new venue in Stockholm that’s slated to open in March 2027. Sections of the site are finished, while in others, we sidle between boxes and pallets of wood, and peer over red tape while the site undergoes its legal assessments. Inside the venue, the scale of the venture becomes clear; our guide says that she’s starstruck every day when she comes into the space. We enter by the rear stage door, facing the pristine, pillarless seated auditorium. It’s easy to see why she feels that way. “Gasometer is not just for Stockholm, or Sweden or the Nordic countries, but for the whole of Europe,” says Planté. The space features two venues: a main auditorium and a second, more intimate venue built into the Gasometer’s roof meant primarily for intimate gatherings,banquets and dinners. Miramis estimates that the investment into the project so far has totaled €100 million ($109 million).  The venue’s first main space, called Theatre, features three levels of stalls seating and a standing area which is customizable depending on the production. title: Morgan Wallen, Garth Brooks, Taylor Swift & More Artists With Most Weeks at No. 1 on Top Country Albums Chart: Full List
summary: Male solo artists dominate, though three female solo artists and two groups have also achieved the feat.
body: Morgan Wallen ’s I’m the Problem leads Billboard ‘s Top Country Albums chart (dated Nov. 28) for the 54th nonconsecutive week. This ups Wallen’s career tally of weeks at No. 1 to 240, allowing him to extend his lead as the artist with the most weeks at No. 1 in the chart’s 62-year history. Wallen’s achievement is especially impressive because he has amassed this hefty total of weeks at No. 1 in such a short amount of time. He first topped the chart a little more than six years ago — on Aug. 15, 2020. I’m the Problem is Wallen’s third album to log a full year at No. 1 on Top Country Albums. Dangerous: The Double Album clung to the top spot for 97 weeks from 2021-23. One Thing at a Time led for 87 weeks from 2023-25. No other artist has spent 52 weeks on top with one album, much less three. Top Country Albums originated as Hot Country Albums in the Jan. 11, 1964 issue of Billboard . Johnny Cash ’s Ring of Fire (The Best of Johnny Cash) headed the inaugural chart. The compilation was well-timed: “Ring of Fire” had headed Hot Country Songs for seven weeks the previous summer and had crossed over to reach the top 20 on the Billboard Hot 100. Th…

title: Twenty One Pilots, The Offspring, Peaches & More: 5 Best Moments in Mexico City’s Corona Capital (Day 2)
summary: Duo Tyler Joseph and Josh Dun bid an indefinite farewell to the stage on the second day of the festival.
body: The second day of Corona Capital 2026 on Saturday (Nov. 21) brought back Twenty One Pilots as the headlining act of the renowned Mexican festival. The duo made up of vocalist Tyler Joseph and drummer Josh Dun performed their final concert of the year in Mexico City, which also marked their last show before an indefinite hiatus, as they indicated during their set. The show turned into a nostalgic and emotional moment, underscoring the deep connection they’ve built with their local fans over the years. On its second day, the music fest gathered approximately 76,000 attendees, according to promoter Ocesa, who enjoyed a diverse lineup of performances, ranging from the energetic ’90s punk of The Offspring and the wild post-hardcore of Pierce the Veil to more subtle moments from the Greek artist Σtella and the refined electronic and French touch of Sebastien Tellier. Yes, I love mine!: 43.5% I didn't buy a Pixel 11 Pro.: 41.0% It's been fine.: 9.8% No, I'm disappointed with it.: 5.7% 1,010 votes We heard from 1,010 readers, and those who purchased the Pixel 11 Pro are pretty satisfied. title: Gemini can now be your go-to source for making GIFs
summary: Gemini follows ChatGPT’s lead with GIF generation.
body: Credit: Joe Maring / Android Authority TL;DR Google has updated Gemini with the ability to create GIFs. Gemini allows the looping animations to be about three seconds long. The feature uses Google’s latest video model, Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash. A couple of weeks back, OpenAI rolled out GIF generation to ChatGPT . Using OpenAI’s new Images 2.6 model, the popular chatbot can now convert text prompts into short looping animations. Playing a bit of catch-up, Google is following suit with a similar rollout. No more having to turn to Giphy or Tenor for your GIF needs. You can now create your own GIFs with Gemini. Google announced the rollout of GIF generation in a social post on X.

title: Motorola ‘Moto Tag 3’ leaks on Amazon, but it looks just like the Moto Tag 2
summary: Looks like Motorola wants to give the Moto Tag 2 a fresh coat and call it the Moto Tag 3.
body: TL;DR Motorola’s unannounced Moto Tag 3 has surfaced in Amazon UK and Italy listings in two new colors: Lucent White and Indigo Blue. The tracker appears to retain the Moto Tag 2’s UWB tracking, Google Find Hub support, IP68 rating, and over 500 days of battery life. With no obvious hardware upgrades, it’s unclear whether the Moto Tag 3 is a genuine successor or simply a color refresh. Motorola’s Moto Tag 3 just leaked on Amazon, and although it dons new colors, there’s little to suggest that it will offer any meaningful upgrades over the Moto Tag 2 . For reference, Motorola hasn’t announced (or even hinted at) a successor to the Moto Tag 2. In fact, the second-gen tracker itself is relatively new. It was announced at CES this year and was made available in select European markets in May. US availability followed in June, so it doesn’t really make sense for the company to be releasing a new tag anytime soon.

title: Garmin smartwatch update makes dogs official workout partners with profiles and badges

body: TL;DR Garmin smartwatch update lets people create profiles for their dogs and include them in workout logging. Users can now keep activities with their pet separate from their other data. There are other changes as well, including improved accuracy when recording swimming. Sometimes your fitness activities include your furry four-legged best friend, and an update for Garmin smartwatches acknowledges that with the ability to create a profile for your dog and include them in your workout logging. Because exercising with a pet is a little more unpredictable than exercising alone, this lets users keep the data separate. Release notes spotted by Gadgets & Wearables in software updates for several Garmin smartwatch models show dog profiles, as well as badges, activities, and activity data associated with dogs.

title: The OSTA O1 Pro is the latest slab phone to join the wide-screen trend
summary: OSTA is a HUAWEI sub-brand, and this is its first-ever smartphone.
body: TL;DR HUAWEI sub-brand OSTA has launched the O1 Pro smartphone, featuring a wide display with a unique 16:9.5 aspect ratio. The smartphone features similar internal hardware to the HUAWEI Pura X View, which launched in China a couple of months ago. This could mark the beginning of a new trend, with a handful of other Chinese brands also expected to launch a wide-screen slab phone. Wide-screen slab phones are gradually emerging as a new form factor, combining the cover screen width of a wide foldable with a traditional slab-type smartphone. HUAWEI threw its hat in the ring with the Pura X View in September , and now, its sub-brand OSTA has joined that list with its debut phone. The OSTA O1 Pro packs a 6.39-inch, 120Hz OLED screen with a 16:9.5 aspect ratio, identical to the Pura X View. It’s only 6.68mm thick and weighs approximately 200 grams, according to the O1 Pro product page .

title: Gboard is testing a new paste shortcut that keeps your formatting intact
summary: Although Android already offers a similar feature, an option in Gboard’s toolbar could make the process even easier.
body: TL;DR Gboard is working on a new toolbar shortcut that lets users paste text while retaining original formatting, including bold, italics, and others. This toolbar option appears to be limited to the most recently copied text, and won’t apply to other items on the clipboard. Android already offers a way to do this, but requires users to long-press the text field and manually pick an option from the context menu. Gboard is comfortably among the best keyboards for Android phones , and it could soon gain an upgraded paste experience for copied text. Right now, Gboard’s toolbar automatically pulls up the clipboard shortcut so you can paste text instantly. However, there’s no option to preserve the original text formatting, with the keyboard defaulting to plain text. It now looks like Gboard is working on changing this in a future update. APK teardown: This reporting is based on work-in-progress code. These features may not ship. We dug into version 18.8.0.10 beta of Gboard to activate an additional toolbar shortcut alongside the existing one, with first-time users seeing an introduction message that reads “Paste while preserving all formatting.”

title: Gboard beta rolls out new clipboard setting that lets you keep copied items for up to 24 hours
summary: Your Gboard clipboard is getting a much longer memory.
body: TL;DR Google is rolling out a new clipboard history setting in Gboard beta. Users can choose how long copied items remain in the clipboard, ranging from the default one hour to 24 hours. Pinned clipboard items will continue to be stored indefinitely, regardless of the selected duration. One frustration with the Gboard clipboard is that you can copy something, get busy with other tasks, and come back to find it gone. That’s because Google’s keyboard automatically clears copied items after an hour unless you pin them. Google is now giving users more control over how long those items stick around. Back in August, we discovered that Google was working on customizable clipboard history in Gboard . Three months later, the feature is starting to roll out to beta users. Android Authority ‘s AssembleDebug, who originally spotted the feature in development, has now received the new clipboard setting in Gboard version 18.8.0 beta.

title: Samsung just made the Galaxy S26 camera better with these One UI 9.5 upgrades

body: Credit: Robert Triggs / Android Authority The One UI 9.5 beta is here, bundled with new goodies for Samsung fans; well, at least if you own a Galaxy S26 , for now. One new feature that particularly caught my eye is the raft of improvements to Samsung’s default camera app. The enhanced Pro and Pro Video modes now offer customizable controls and presets to help you better tailor your shots to tricky shooting conditions. Sounds promising. Getting started with these new features is simple. Just open the camera app and switch to either Pro mode for photos or Pro Video for footage . Both modes share the same general layout and customization options, although there are a few differences worth exploring.

title: Samsung’s Auto Blocker won’t switch off during calls in One UI 9.5
summary: Auto Blocker is getting stricter with One UI 9.5 and scammers won't like it.
body: Credit: Ryan Haines / Android Authority TL;DR With One UI 9.5, users won’t be able to change Auto Blocker settings during a call. This is to thwart scammers trying to get people to disable security features. The feature is already live in the first One UI 9.5 beta on the Galaxy S26. Samsung’s One UI comes with Auto Blocker , which warns you before sideloading APKs and protects your Galaxy phone or tablet from malicious execution over USB or from harmful files received via messaging apps. With One UI 9.5 beta that rolled out to the Galaxy S26 series earlier this week, Auto Blocker appears to be getting additional anti-scam features that prevent hackers from misguiding users during calls. Since Auto Blocker prevents unauthorized apps from being installed, scammers may often attempt to lure users into changing security settings on their devices. Getting users to change these settings makes it easier for scammers to install malicious apps and take over these devices. To prevent this, Samsung is raising the threshold for Auto Blocker and adding measures that prevent users from changing crucial settings while they’re on calls.

title: Samsung’s Driving Report in One UI 9.5 could tell you when you’re too tired to be driving
summary: It could also remember the floor where you parkerd your vehicle in a multi-level parking.
body: Credit: Pankil Shah / Android Authority TL;DR Samsung could upgrade Driving Report in One UI 9.5, giving you more personalized insights about your driving habits. It could check the weather and your sleep quality ahead of the drive. It could also remember the exact parking spot along with the floor level. Samsung introduced the Driving Report feature in One UI 9. It automatically logs your driving habits while your phone is connected to the car’s head unit and breaks them down by counting instances of sudden acceleration or braking, phone use, or sharp turns. At the end of every week, you get a summary through Now Brief. With One UI 9.5, which has just landed in beta , Samsung may add more features to Driving Report, including parking spots, saving your preferred routes, and more personalized warnings.

title: Google confirms native app lock won’t come to older Android versions
summary: App lock needs more than a Play system update.
body: TL;DR Google has confirmed that Android’s native app lock cannot be backported to older Android versions via Play System updates. The current implementation depends on new APIs in the core Android platform. Users will need an Android OS update, not a Google Play System update, to get Google’s current implementation of App Lock. Between Samsung introducing native app lock in One UI 9.5 this week and Google restoring the feature in Android 17 QPR3 Beta 3 last month, it’s been a good few weeks for Android users who value their privacy. And with Google increasingly delivering Android features outside of major OS updates , some users are wondering whether their phones could get native app locking without upgrading to the latest version of Android. Unfortunately, this isn’t one of those features.

title: How to use App Lock in One UI 9.5 (and when Secure Folder is still better)
summary: Finally, app privacy without the extra steps.
body: Credit: Pankil Shah / Android Authority App Lock has to be one of the most highly requested One UI features of all time. It’s something so basic, and yet Samsung hasn’t offered it for all these years. That’s finally changing. Samsung recently released the first beta of One UI 9.5 for the Galaxy S26 series, and it brings native app locking. Here’s how it works, and why it’s still not a replacement for Secure Folder. One UI 9.5 brings native app locking to Samsung phones

title: Gemini could soon make it easy to find chats where you left unfinished draft text
summary: We could also be getting Markdown export on the mobile app.
body: TL;DR Google is working on indicators to show when you’ve left a draft message in Gemini chats. Users would be able to filter the chat list to only show those with active drafts. Gemini’s also working on new tools for sharing chat output and Live prompts. Working with an AI as powerful as Gemini can be a little overwhelming — where do you even start, with so many options available to you — and if you frequently find yourself leaving things hanging before you finish sharing your latest thoughts with Gemini, you just might appreciate what looks like a new feature for managing your drafts. We’ve uncovered evidence for just that, as well as new tools for sharing your Gemini sessions, in a recent app update. APK teardown: This reporting is based on work-in-progress code. These features may not ship. Gemini already saves drafts that you’ve started writing but have yet to submit. The problem right now is that there’s no good way to find them. If you pull up your list of past chats, when you tap on one you’ll see any draft text still in the box, but there’s no way to know that’s there from your main list of chats in the app’s menu.

title: Google Docs adds 3 new caption and cross-reference features to simplify complex documents
summary: The updates are rolling out today to all users.
body: TL;DR Google Docs gets three new features: inline captions, cross-references, and tables of captions. The changes are designed to make creating academic papers, reports, and technical documentation easier. For as easy as Google Docs can make things, there are some tasks that are still quite tedious, but now some are becoming a little less so with the introduction of three new features : inline captions, cross-references, and tables of captions. The trio looks particularly helpful when creating long, complex documents such as academic papers, reports, and technical documentation.

title: New Motorola Razr Flex renders offer best look yet at wide-body foldable
summary: The Razr Flex shows up in 2 colors for these high-res renders.
body: TL;DR Motorola is supposedly developing a new wide-body foldable, expected to arrive as the Razr Flex. New renders have arrived that appear to show off the hardware in both green and beige colorways. The renders match the leaked pic we shared earlier today, and differ in quite a few ways from earlier mock-ups. Motorola’s foldable ambitions look like they’re only continuing to grow, and after this year’s expansion with the Razr Fold , we’re now looking forward to the wide-body Razr Flex — and some new imagery gives us maybe our best look at this hardware yet. Following that single Razr Flex image we shared with you a few hours ago, we’ve now got some much more detailed pics to check out, thanks to SammyGuru . The very clean-looking set of renders depicts the Razr Flex in a variety of poses, and highlights both green and beige colorways, previously identified as PANTONE Dark Botanical Garden and PANTONE Coriander.
